section.11: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

11.name_native: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Jabir bin Samurah that :The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite "By the heaven holding the big stars" and: "By the heaven, and At-Tariq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star)" and similar surahs in Zuhr and 'Asr
